description: Install frontend dependencies and verify the baseline type-check and lint pass cleanly before making changes.
steps: Run `cd web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` to install all frontend dependencies.
Run `cd web && pnpm typecheck` to confirm TypeScript compilation passes.
Run `cd web && pnpm lint` to confirm linting passes.
If any issues are found, note them in findings but do NOT fix pre-existing issues.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm lint` exits with code 0 or only pre-existing warnings
findings: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile: SUCCESS (735 packages). pnpm lint: SUCCESS (exit 0). pnpm typecheck: FAILED (exit 2) with 5 pre-existing TS errors in app/routes/groups.$slug.tsx and app/routes/groups._index.tsx. Errors relate to EmptyState component prop mismatch (message vs title) and LoadMore callback return type mismatch (items vs results). These are pre-existing issues not introduced by this task.
